flow.name: 09 · TryCatch · flaky HTTP with fallback + log
flow.notes: Webhook → tries an HTTP call to httpbin.org/status/503 (which always fails) → catch posts a fallback notification with the error reason → finally appends a line to a log file. Tests TryCatch full pipeline: try-fails branch, intoErrorVar var capture, fallback notification, finally always runs, WriteFile in APPEND mode. Trigger: curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8821/hook/flaky --data 'test'. Inspect the log later via 'adb shell run-as com.flowdroid cat files/automation/logs/flaky.log'.
